name: @hagioscopio/web-app-dev-team
description: A deterministic Codex team for building internal web applications.
author: hagioscopio

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:cli && bun run build:watcher
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js run
scripts.tmux: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js run
scripts.restore: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js restore
scripts.restore:resume: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js restore:resume
scripts.restore:status: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js restore:status
scripts.git:resume: bun run build && bun run --env-file=.env dist/cli.js git-resume
scripts.demo: bun run build && bun run dist/cli.js demo
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run complexity && bun run test
scripts.package:test: bun run build && bun test test/package
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build && bun run package:test && bun run package:inspect
